risks.title: Unauthorized access to financial applications
risks.statement: Users are granted access to in-scope financial applications without documented business-owner approval, or retain access that is no longer commensurate with their role, allowing unauthorized or erroneous transactions to be recorded in the general ledger and subledgers.
risks.fs_impact: Unauthorized journal entries, loan adjustments or payments recorded in financial statements

risks.title: Terminated users retain system access
risks.statement: Access for terminated employees and contractors is not removed timely, allowing former personnel (or others using their credentials) to initiate or approve transactions after separation.
risks.fs_impact: Fraudulent or unauthorized transactions posted under a departed user's ID

risks.title: Inappropriate privileged access
risks.statement: Privileged (administrator, superuser, DBA) access is granted without independent authorization, enabling users to bypass application controls, alter configurations, or modify financial data directly.
risks.fs_impact: Direct data changes or disabled automated controls that bypass segregation of duties

risks.title: Unauthorized changes to financial systems
risks.statement: Changes to applications, interfaces, or configurations supporting financial reporting are implemented to production without independent approval, introducing processing or calculation errors.
risks.fs_impact: Misstated balances from faulty calculations, interfaces or report logic

risks.title: Failed changes cannot be reversed
risks.statement: Production changes are implemented without a documented back-out (rollback) plan, so a failed change causes prolonged processing outages or corrupted financial data that cannot be restored reliably.
risks.fs_impact: Incomplete or corrupted period-end data; delayed close

controls.control_description: Requests for new or modified (non-privileged) access to in-scope financial applications are submitted through the access request system and approved by the user's manager before the IT Access Management team provisions access. Provisioning without a recorded approver is not permitted.
controls.test_attribute_exception_definition: Grant has a recorded approver who is not the grantee.
controls.test_of_operating_effectiveness: Obtain the FY2025 access provisioning log; filter to non-privileged grants in period; confirm each grant carries an approver ID and that the approver is not the grantee.

controls.control_description: Upon notification of a separation, IT Access Management removes all application access for the terminated user within five (5) business days of the termination date.
controls.test_attribute_exception_definition: Every grant held at the termination date ends within 5 business days after it.
controls.test_of_operating_effectiveness: Obtain the HR termination listing for FY2025 and the access log; for each terminated employee identify all grants active at the termination date; compute business days from termination to access end date; flag grants revoked after the SLA or still active at the as-of date.

controls.control_description: HR Operations notifies IT Access Management of each separation via the HR system feed or ticket within one (1) business day of the termination date, triggering the revocation workflow.
controls.test_attribute_exception_definition: HR-notified date is no more than 1 business day after termination date.
controls.test_of_operating_effectiveness: For each FY2025 termination compute business days between the termination date and the HR-notified date; flag notifications later than 1 business day.

controls.control_description: Each quarter, application owners review a system-generated listing of all user and privileged accounts for each in-scope application, certify appropriateness and request removal of inappropriate access. Reviews are completed within 30 days of quarter end.
controls.test_attribute_exception_definition: Review completed, by an assigned reviewer, on or before the due date.
controls.test_of_operating_effectiveness: Obtain the FY2025 access review tracker; confirm a review exists for every system-quarter, that it was completed on or before the due date and that a reviewer is recorded.

controls.control_description: Privileged access (Administrator, Superuser, Database Administrator) is granted only upon a documented approval from the system owner in the privileged access approval register, matching the requested system and access level, and dated on or before the grant.
controls.test_population_source: data/user_access_log.csv (privileged grants in FY2025) vs data/privileged_access_approvals.csv
controls.test_attribute_exception_definition: Matching approval record (ticket, employee, system, access level) dated on/before the grant date.
controls.test_of_operating_effectiveness: Filter the access log to privileged access levels granted in FY2025; match each grant to the approval register by request ticket; confirm employee, system and access level agree and approval date <= grant date.

controls.control_description: Approvers of privileged access requests must be independent of the requester; self-approval is prohibited and blocked by workflow configuration.
controls.test_attribute_exception_definition: Approver ID differs from the employee receiving access.
controls.test_of_operating_effectiveness: For each privileged approval record supporting an FY2025 grant, compare the approver ID to the grantee ID; flag self-approvals.

controls.control_description: Normal and standard changes to in-scope applications are approved by the Change Advisory Board (CAB) prior to production implementation. Emergency changes may be implemented first but must be retrospectively approved within two (2) business days.
controls.test_attribute_exception_definition: Approver recorded; approval before implementation (emergency: within 2 BD after).
controls.test_of_operating_effectiveness: Obtain the FY2025 production change log; for each change confirm an approver and approval timestamp exist; for normal/standard changes confirm approval precedes implementation; for emergency changes confirm approval within 2 business days after implementation.

controls.control_description: Every production change record includes a documented back-out (rollback) plan, reviewed by the CAB as part of change approval.
controls.test_attribute_exception_definition: Rollback plan field indicates a documented plan exists.
controls.test_of_operating_effectiveness: Normalize the rollback-plan indicator (Yes/Y/yes/No/N) and flag changes without a documented rollback plan.

controls.control_title: Segregation of duties in change approval
controls.control_description: The individual approving a change cannot be the individual who requested or developed it.
controls.test_attribute_exception_definition: Approver ID differs from requester ID.
controls.test_of_operating_effectiveness: Compare requested_by to approved_by for each approved change; flag matches.
